q: In a diode detector, the time constant $RC$ is made less than the period of the carrier wave to ensure complete discharge between cycles.

While discharging, voltage decays toward zero as a pure exponential with the same RC. The printed line wrongly says in a diode detector, the time constant RC is made less than the period of the carrier wave to ensure complete discharge between cycles.
